title: Synthetic Safe Routing Policy
synthetic_policy_notice: Fictional demonstration policy only. Not a real lender policy and not for lending decisions.

sections.title: Model failure
sections.text: A quantitative model failure must not produce an invented probability of default or SHAP result. Preserve the failure and route the unresolved case to human review under deterministic workflow control.

sections.title: Verification failure
sections.text: A failed or unavailable verification result must not create verified evidence. Preserve the failure, retain the reported value separately, and route unresolved required evidence to human review.

sections.title: Policy conflict
sections.text: Conflicting or unavailable synthetic policy evidence must not be interpreted as approval. Preserve each source and version, expose the conflict, and route unresolved policy ambiguity to human review.
